comparison.objective: Refit a delta-printer arm pair onto an effector's paired ball studs.
comparison.physical_skill: Align two sockets simultaneously, elastically spread the arm pair, and snap both sockets over balls.
comparison.success_condition: Both sockets must be centered on one stud pair at the specified sprung width, with the effector flat and both grippers clear.
comparison.reason: This is the closest insertion-style neighbor, but its defining ability is simultaneous elastic spreading and snap-fit retention onto two studs. The candidate requires maintaining a flush, parallel support bridge while sliding a recirculating carriage without losing any free ball.
